summary: 3.7.23–3.7.27 resolve well-known `--proto-dir` imports, bound replay memory, backfill startup mocks after a cut, let you ignore a response field for one endpoint, and quiet normal-mode replay output.
3.7.20–3.7.22 clarify default-mode replay, fix MySQL window ownership, omit unconsumed background mocks from obsolete verdicts, fail-closed inverted windows, and compare gRPC bodies by field number.
Lists a test's background misses in its evidence, treats undeclared startup-recording calls as that test's miss under `KEPLOY_PROVEN=1`, and spends a once-series recording answered outside tests.
3.7.17–3.7.18 reuse MySQL setup probes across tests, serve declared session and @startup mocks to every test, mark background HTTP misses, and honour a No to the Windows CA prompt.
3.7.13–3.7.16 refresh Mozilla TLS roots, fix Postman importer panics and a path-traversal, tighten file permissions, preserve JSON numbers above 2^53, and fix HTTP/1.1 pipelining and IPv6-only pods.

3.7.11–3.7.12 fix Windows socket take accounting, MySQL summary truncation, tzdata zone matching, and a memory-guard GOMEMLIMIT from the container limit. New apps are named from the git repo and path.
Counts a consumed or spent mock as served in the same locked step that takes it, so a held Redis-style pop no longer hangs after another worker takes the job.
3.7.8–3.7.9 stop logging request bytes and credentials, fix a matcher hang on slim DST zone files, and print mock-miss paths in full on the console instead of in receipts.
3.7.3–3.7.7 fix IPv6 hosts in test targets and Docker/Compose port maps, installer/sudo Docker retries, MySQL pipelining, and mock-sync drops. Adds named worker-mock rules served to every test.
3.7.2 uses the Docker CLI's current context (Rancher Desktop) and no longer records HTTP streams as test cases. 3.7.1 fixes agent PID mapping, loopback ports, `//path` parsing, and MySQL mock errors.
Adds a parser-contract for mock-noise and miss reporting. Reusable mocks now keep the union of learned `req_body_noise`, so saved mock files can change (#4943).
